title: Quietly Indulgent Italian Borlotti Beans Bruschetta
description: A spicy and velvety Italian dish featuring borlotti beans, perfect for a quiet indulgent snack, made without onion or garlic for a friendly twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mash the borlotti beans using a fork or a potato masher.
Add the diced tomatoes, red pepper flakes, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt, and black pepper to the bowl with the mashed beans.
Stir the mixture until it is well combined and the flavors are evenly distributed.
Arrange the toasted italian bread slices on a baking sheet.
Spoon the bean and tomato mixture over the bread slices, leaving a small border around the edges.
Sprinkle the shredded mozzarella cheese over the top of the bean mixture.
Bake the bruschetta in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the bruschetta from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh basil leaves.
Serve the Quietly Indulgent Italian Borlotti Beans Bruschetta warm and enjoy.
